findings.summary: Scrub leaked internal operator directives from public briefing posts
evidence: content-site/src/content/briefings/2026-11-01.md:32 contained Operator Takeaways naming Sigil and Toolforge
historical briefings 2026-10-23 through 2026-10-31 contained internal operator directives
scrubbed across 8 briefing markdown files in commit a7b5f01 and 2fe1450
findings.suggestion: Enforce strict schema separation between public Industry & Architecture Takeaways and private operator directives in daily-ai-news-summary, and add an automated pre-merge regex check in rewritelabs.io CI to block internal repo names.

findings.summary: Strip UTF-8 BOM in briefing payload parsers to prevent JSON syntax errors
evidence: content-site/scripts/publish-briefing.mjs crashed with Unexpected token ﻿ when reading exported Drive payload
findings.suggestion: Sanitize leading UTF-8 BOM across all payload reader scripts before calling JSON.parse.

findings.summary: Save Google Drive daily briefing payloads as raw JSON to prevent gdoc shortcut sync
evidence: G:\My Drive\AI\briefing-payload.json synced as .gdoc shortcut because Drive file was created as application/vnd.google-apps.document
publish-briefing.mjs failed with ENOENT on Windows Google Drive for Desktop
findings.suggestion: Save daily briefing payloads with MIME type application/json or export via Drive API before dispatching.
